description: This source file 'wld_util.c' contains utility functions for a wireless device driver or related software module. It includes functions for string manipulation, numeric conversions, bitmask operations, country code handling, WEP and WPA key validation, random number generation, and interface state control. The file also defines data structures and constants used across the project, supporting various operational and configuration tasks.
